card.name: Words setting up a scaled amount
card.fires_on: Small linking or adjusting words right where a quantity is about to be tied to another change, such as a comma after 'if the dose is increased', 'appropriate' before 'amount', or 'correspondingly' before 'smaller doses'.

modes.label: Conditional comma
modes.description: A comma ending an 'if X is increased' or 'should X not fit' clause, before the instruction on what to do.

modes.label: Proportional wording
modes.description: Words that start a 'more X, accordingly more Y' relation between amounts.
modes.example: Devices with more rows<< have>> accordingly longer retention times.
